content_blocks.body: This haveli belonged to a merchant family for six generations. After years of restoration, we opened its courtyard to celebrations, with care to keep the paint, stone and woodwork exactly as they should be.

items: One event per day, never shared
No nails, tape or adhesive on walls
No fireworks or open flame outside the lit area
Only approved decorators may use the building
Music stops at 11 PM in the courtyard

content_blocks.title: From a recent couple
content_blocks.body: We were worried a heritage building would feel restrictive. The team made it feel like our own home for the weekend.

items.q: Can we bring our own decorator?
items.a: Yes, after sharing their plan so our heritage team can approve it.

items.q: Is it good for photoshoots on non-wedding days?
items.a: Yes. We offer half-day shoot bookings on weekdays at a lower rate.

venues.name: Bandra Loft Photo and Video Studio
venues.tagline: North-light loft studio with cyclorama wall, for shoots and workshops
venues.address: 2nd Floor, Perry Cross Lane, Bandra West
venues.capacity_note: 25 for a workshop, 12 for a shoot crew
venues.description: A loft studio with tall windows on the north side, so you get soft daylight all morning. A white cyclorama wall, a brick backdrop and a small lifestyle set are ready to use. There is a makeup room, wardrobe racks and a lounge area for clients. Many of our bookings are product and fashion shoots, but the room also works well for small workshops and pop-up sales. Equipment such as light stands, softboxes and backdrop paper can be added on request, and a house assistant is available to help with setup and cleanup for a small fee.

rental_options.note: Minimum 2 hours. Lighting kit is 1500 rupees extra.

purposes.note: Includes cyclorama wall and brick backdrop.
Chairs and a projector on request.

items: Best natural light is 9 AM to 1 PM
Access to the studio is by stairs only
Cyclorama must be left clean after use

items.a: No. We rent the space and equipment only, but can introduce local photographers.

items.q: Can I bring my own lights?
items.a: Yes. Please inform us so we can plan your power load.

venues.name: Koramangala Padel and Pickleball Courts
venues.tagline: Two glass-wall padel courts and one pickleball court
venues.capacity_note: 4 players per padel court, 4 on the pickleball court
venues.description: Two glass-wall padel courts and one dedicated pickleball court in a covered, well-lit hall. Racquets and balls can be rented at the desk, and a coach is available for beginner clinics. The hall has fans and a good drainage system, so rain never stops a game. A small cafe next door serves coffee and light snacks. Beginners are welcome: a short coaching session helps you understand the walls and scoring, and our desk can match you with partners at a similar level on busy evenings.

purposes.note: Beginner clinics on Saturday mornings.

items: Two padel courts with glass walls
Wipe the court after heavy rain
Padel racquets are available at the desk

items.a: No. Most people enjoy a full rally on their first day with a short coaching session.

reviews.content: Hosted our haldi and mehendi here. The lawn looked beautiful in the evening and the caretaker team helped with every small thing. Parking was never a problem.
Played a corporate cricket day on the weekday pitch. Ground was well kept and the pavilion was a nice touch. Washrooms could be a little cleaner.
Booked it for my sister's reception with about 450 guests. Plenty of space, good lighting and the generator never failed. Highly recommended.
Great value for such a big lawn. Check the rain plan before booking, we had to add a tent at the last minute.
The hall and lawn worked together perfectly for our wedding. Bridal suite was spacious and the staff was patient with all our rituals.
Beautiful chandeliers and good air conditioning. Decor packages are a bit expensive but the quality is good.
Guest rooms were very useful for our relatives from Kanpur. Parking for 150 cars really helps on a wedding day.
Perfect weekend away for my birthday. The pool was clean, the bonfire area was lovely and the caretaker cooked a great breakfast.
Quiet and green. The drive takes a while at night, so plan transport in advance. Rooms are simple but comfortable.
We shot a pre-wedding video here and the orchard light in the morning was gorgeous. Would book again.
Very fair price for a full day. Kitchen and courtyard made our puja lunch easy to manage. Hall needs a fresh coat of paint.
Booked for a kitty party. The staff was kind and everything was clean. The location near the bus terminal suited our guests.
Good for the price but the coolers are noisy in the afternoon. Bring extra fans if you have a big crowd.
Best turf in the area. Lights are bright, the surface is soft, and the staff is on time. Our Sunday group plays here every week.
Box cricket cage is excellent. Ball goes back to the bowler nicely and the scoreboard is a good touch.
Great experience. Evening slots book out fast, so reserve early. Cafeteria could have more snacks.
Clean changing rooms and free parking. Peak hour rates are slightly high but worth it for the quality.
Floor is smooth and the lighting does not glare. My daughter joined the weekend coaching and has improved a lot.
Good courts and a friendly desk team. It gets warm in summer evenings, so bring a towel.
Reasonable price per hour and clear booking system. Racquet rental is handy when friends forget theirs.
Hosted my son's birthday here. The shallow area was perfect for the little ones and the lifeguard was attentive.
Clean pool and a nice shaded deck. Music had to stop by 8 PM which was fine for us.
Good place for a friends' pool day. Showers were hot and the changing rooms were clean.
Our two-day training ran without a single technical problem. Projector, mics and internet were solid, and the technician stayed throughout.
Central location and a very professional setup. Lunch from their partner was tasty and on time.
Good hall for our product launch. Parking is tight, so ask guests to carpool or use valet.
We have booked it three times for investor meetings. Always clean, quiet and well managed.
Perfect for interviews. Quiet room, great WiFi and the reception welcomed our candidates well.
Compact but well equipped. The whiteboard wall was handy for our planning session.
Booked the small room for a client call. No distractions and tea was free. Easy to extend our slot.
Our office football league plays here every Thursday. Pitch is in great shape and the floodlights are strong.
Good facilities and fair pricing for Gurugram. Parking is easy. The canteen menu could be longer.
Clean turf and professional staff. Weekend slots go quickly.
We got married here and every photo looks like a painting. The heritage team was thoughtful and kept the day on schedule.
The rooftop at sunset was unforgettable. Rooms for family were comfortable and the staff was warm.
Beautiful building and a unique setting. The no-nails rule means decor takes planning, but it is worth it.
Great light and an easy cyclorama wall. Booked for a product shoot and we finished ahead of time.
Good studio for the price in Bandra. Stairs only, so plan for heavy equipment.
Lovely daylight and a very helpful team. The makeup room made our long shoot much easier.
